tunnel.title: Tunnel sync
tunnel.description: Connect your devices through your own Cloudflare Tunnel. The host must stay online; DeepChat does not manage the tunnel process.
tunnel.ingress: Point your named tunnel ingress at this local service:
tunnel.quickWarning: Quick Tunnels use a new URL after restart. Pair the receiving device again when the URL changes.
tunnel.publishHelp: Only an explicitly published snapshot is shared. Publish again to share newer data; regular backups do not update it.
tunnel.incrementHelp: Incremental import adds missing records only. Edits and deletions of existing records are not propagated. Imported settings and credentials follow the existing backup restore behavior.
tunnel.encryptionHelp: Encrypted host backups are not supported by tunnel sync yet. Encryption keys are never transferred.
tunnel.consent: Snapshots contain conversations, settings, provider API keys and any credentials included in MCP configuration. Every paired device can download them. Cloudflare terminates HTTPS; payloads are not end-to-end encrypted. Enable host sharing with these contents?
tunnel.overwriteWarning: This replaces local data with the published host snapshot and stops active sessions during import. Download cancellation is available until import starts. Continue?

error.consentRequired: Confirm that snapshots contain credentials before enabling host sharing.
error.disableFirst: Disable the host before changing its port.
error.bindFailed: Could not bind the loopback port. Choose another port and try again.
error.busy: Another operation is in progress. Try again after it finishes.
error.credentialsUnavailable: Pairing credentials could not be read or unlocked. Check the system keychain and pair again.
error.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTPS origin, without a path, query, fragment or embedded credentials.
error.invalidPairing: Paste the complete pairing details from the host.
error.overwriteConfirmation: Confirm replacement before starting an overwrite import.
error.hostChanged: The address belongs to a different host. Verify the address and pair again.
error.unsupportedHost: The host does not support this sync protocol. Update both devices.
error.invalidResponse: The host returned an invalid snapshot or response.
error.unauthorized: Pairing failed or device access was revoked. Check the pairing details and any Cloudflare Access policy.
error.noSnapshot: The host has not published a snapshot. Publish one on the host first.
error.rateLimited: The host is receiving too many requests. Wait a minute and retry.
error.connectionFailed: Could not complete the connection. Check the host and tunnel, then retry.
error.notPaired: Pair with a host before pulling a snapshot.
error.encryptedSnapshot: This host snapshot is encrypted. Tunnel sync cannot import encrypted backups yet; no data was imported.
error.integrityFailed: Snapshot verification failed. The partial download was discarded; retry to download it again.
error.diskFull: There is not enough free disk space for the snapshot.
error.snapshotChanged: The published snapshot changed. Retry to download the current snapshot.
error.cleanupFailed: Data was imported, but the sync record or download cleanup failed. Check directory permissions.
error.storageFailed: Could not read or write local sync files. Check directory permissions and disk health.
